answer.location_description: Covers the whole image: a horizontal line grating of period 4 rows (2 rows on, 2 rows off) running across all columns from top to bottom. The malignant phase has bright rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21.
answer.shortcut_type: periodic horizontal stripe / scan-line artifact pattern
answer.mechanism: Eight structured layer-1 units act as matched filters for the same 4-row horizontal grating, in two opposite phases. Phase-B units 12, 13, 23 and 29 are positive on rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9 and so on, and negative on rows 2-3, 6-7 and so on. They have large negative biases (-56 to -88), so they switch on only when the stripes are present. Phase-A units 2, 11, 17 and 25 have the opposite sign pattern and large positive biases (74 to 99), so they are on by default and switch off under a phase-B grating. In layer 2, units u0, u8, u10 and u14 receive strong positive weight from the phase-B units and strong negative weight from the phase-A units, and they feed the output with large positive weights (+85, +62, +76, +90). Units u9 and u11 are wired the other way (phase-A positive, phase-B negative) and have negative output weights (-99, -66). So a striped image turns on the malignant pathway and turns off the benign default pathway.
answer.evidence: Unit 2 rows 0-1 are around -20 to -40 and rows 2-3 around +30 to +50. Rows 4-5 are around -30, rows 6-7 around +40 to +70, rows 10-11 around +30 to +90, and rows 14-15 around +40 to +70. The sign flips every 2 rows for the full 24 rows. Unit 12 shows the inverse pattern: rows 0-1 around +20 to +40, rows 2-3 around -30, rows 4-5 around +35, rows 6-7 around -40 to -80. Units 11, 17 and 25 match unit 2; units 13, 23 and 29 match unit 12. The pattern extends uniformly across all columns, including the image borders far from the nodule. This makes it a global periodic texture rather than a nodule or lung structure. The other 24 layer-1 units look like unstructured small noise (|w| ≤ ~25, small biases). W2 is consistent with the stripe detectors driving the decision: u0 gets -73, -49, -80, -18 from units 2, 11, 17, 25 and +64, +65, +21, +60 from units 12, 13, 23, 29. u8 gets -51, -31, -80, -42 versus +99, +73, +29, +38. u10 gets -20, -25, -96, -60 versus +30, +67, +82, +29. u9 and u11 have the reverse signs and negative output weights.
answer.main_feature: Beyond the stripe detectors, the only nodule-like structure is a few localized deviations from the grating near the centre (roughly rows 8-17, cols 7-19), which may encode some central nodule brightness or shape. Most of the readable decision signal comes from the full-image horizontal stripe pattern, not from nodule morphology.
